PA PUC order on the Paupack 230 kV lines (docket A-2012-2309315) names the Peckville Substation and the Blooming Grove-Peckville 230 kV line (PPL) but gives no street location, so the match to the point rests on the name (point is in Peckville/Blakely, Lackawanna Co.); scanned PUC PDFs could not be read and the sources imply an existing, long-standing substation.

PJM X3-028 study (Grain Belt, ca. 2015) names the AEP Breed 345 kV substation, and AEP's CCR posting puts the former Breed plant at 39.2275,-87.5731 (~250 m from the point); contractor ECI says AEP decommissioned Breed Station and replaced it with a new 345 kV station next to Sullivan 765 kV about 1.5 mi NE, so the yard is probably retired or removed (the site is now proposed for an X-energy SMR plant, Oct 2026), and HIFLD's Breed line endpoints are likely out of date.
